name.ja: ケロロ軍曹プラモコレクション ケロロ軍曹
name.en: Keroro Sergeant Plastic Model Collection Keroro Sergeant

description.ja: アニメ「ケロロ軍曹」の主人公“ケロロ軍曹”が1/6スケールで堂々のプラモデル化であります！
description.en: The main character of the anime "Keroro Sergeant" is a 1/6 scale plastic model!

description.ja: 首、腕、足など各関節が可動、腕と足はパーツの差し替えで異なるアクションポ－ズも再現可能。
description.en: Each joint such as the neck, arms, and legs are movable, and different action poses can be recreated by replacing parts of the arms and legs.

description.ja: 顔を回転させると目が切り替わり、様々な表情が再現可能。
description.en: When you rotate the face, the eyes change and various expressions can be reproduced.

description.ja: 劇中に登場した様々なガンプラ小物が付属。
description.en: Includes various Gunpla accessories that appeared in the movie.

description.ja: いろプラとシールで設定色を簡単再現。
description.en: Easily reproduce the set color with Iropla and Seal.
